t: You're looking at the Royal Artillery Boer War Memorial, on the south side of The Mall, near the junction with Horse Guards Road at the corner of St James's Park. Unveiled in 1910, it marks the 1,083 Royal Artillery soldiers who died in the Second Boer War, from 1899 to 1902. It has been listed since 1970. Aston Webb, who designed the principal facade of Buckingham Palace, was the architect. William Robert Colton, a sculptor who also made busts, statues and war memorials, made the sculpture.
